answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions. Each identity must solve an inherently sequential cryptographic puzzle, ensuring clones cannot simply mirror one output. An attacker incurs a non-parallelizable wall-clock time latency and dedicated processor cycle per persona, making frictionless agent proliferation a fable. However, attackers with specialized ASIC hardware calculate proofs significantly faster, turning high-end fabrication into an exclusionary haven.
